fields.statement: At b384c062 I read the diff: trimGoCache leaves settingDefs, daemonConf and daemonConfOf, daemonSweepGoCache and the gosweep import leave internal/api/daemon.go, daemon-trims-go-cache.txtar is deleted, and docs/reference/config.md drops the setting. Nothing outside internal/gosweep itself references gosweep or trimGoCache in Go, scripts or docs. Ran with a private GOTMPDIR: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-settings|docs-reference)' passes all 6 scripts; daemon-settings-scope now asserts ! stdout 'trimGoCache' on rhiza daemon settings. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Daemon|Docs|Setting' passes from a scratch worktree outside ~/code (it trips the known .rhiza-root usage leak guard under ~/code); noDiskReads no longer answers trimGoCache. rhiza docs --out from this build writes a config.md identical to docs/reference/config.md, with no trimGoCache. The retirements of daemon-trims-go-cache and go-build-cache-sweep are in the change set.
